summary: Spyre Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Items 7.01 (Regulation FD) and 8.01 (Other Events) on September 8, 2026, disclosing positive 12-week induction topline data from Part A of the Phase 2 SKYLINE trial of SPY003, an anti-IL-23 for moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. SPY003 met its primary endpoint with a 10.0-point reduction in Robarts Histopathology Index score (p<0.0001), plus 20% clinical remission and 30% endoscopic improvement. No deal, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated; this is a clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation.
